The Stevens Branch corridor and the wooded quarry country around Barre Town keep animals moving through neighborhoods nightly, and mice are a fall constant everywhere.

Our crew's Barre rhythm is fall proofing before a hard Washington County winter, spring denning calls, and bat exclusions timed for spring or late August through fall with one-way doors. Older Barre homes usually have several entries, so we inspect the whole roofline on every call — call us and we will find them all.
